items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: He's still there. In fact, I saw him down there with Sammy Davis last -- about a year ago when Sammy had a show.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, it was after that era. He'd begun -- they guys had begun to drift away, you know. Like Willie Smith had gone, Crawford, you know. And that was the tail end of Jimmy Lunceford days, you know. And stayed down there six months. Went to Acapulco and played at a club called the La Perlo, that was owned by -- oh, he was married to Hedy Lamarr. He's still there. In fact, I saw him down there with Sammy Davis last -- about a year ago when Sammy had a show. We went down there and did a series of shows on the…
